description_en: Queries high availability (HA) logs for an instance
description_zh: 查询实例高可用相关日志
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-ha-logs --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000000 --db-node-id pi-0000000000000000 --page-number 1 --page-size 30 --start-time 2025-05-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-05-23T01:01:00Z --log-type HaSwitchLogList --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHALogs

parameters.help_en:
The node ID.

> 这是一个optional 字段，需要增加一个条件If specified,If specified, queries the high availability (HA) switchover records of `DBNodeId`. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to view the detailed information about all clusters under your account, including node IDs
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。
> 查询`DBNodeId`的HA切换记录。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息，包括节点ID
parameters.name: db_node_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 5 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，取值：5~50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The time follows the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format (UTC time)
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始日期。格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. The time follows the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format (UTC time)
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需晚于查询开始时间。格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time
